name: Affirmations with a Stinkbug
source:
Rain can mean a lot of things for a lot of different people. For people like Cirro, it`s a reminder of the lives lost and forgotten. Thankfully, they`re hardly alone in times like these. 

Play through a brief conversation with their housemate, Stinkbug, or his alter, Edgar Halys and listen to their rainy shower affirmations. 

[From [url=https://the-riversitters.itch.io/affirmations-with-a-stinkbug]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
雨对于很多不同的人来说意味着很多事情。对于像西罗这样的人来说，它提醒人们失去和被遗忘的生命。值得庆幸的是，在这样的时刻，他们并不孤单。

与他们的室友Stinkbug或他的同伴埃德加·哈利斯 (Edgar Halys) 进行简短的对话，并聆听他们在阵雨中的肯定。

[来自[url=https://the-riversitters.itch.io/affirmations-with-a-stinkbug]itch.io[/url]]
